name: How long does new room construction usually take in the East Bay area?

mainEntity.name: How long does new room construction usually take in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for new room construction varies depending on the project's complexity, size, and the specific permitting requirements of your city (e.g., Berkeley, Oakland, Albany). Generally, a standard room addition can take anywhere from 3 to 6 months from initial design to completion. This includes time for architectural plans, permit approvals, and the actual construction phase. We will provide a detailed schedule after the initial design phase.
